app.title: Universal Translator
voice.hint: Tap the mic, speak in the From language, and hear the translation.
voice.tip: Tip: Microsoft Edge usually lists extra online voices (including Amharic). Chrome often has fewer.
talk.hint: Two-person mode: each person taps their own button and speaks. The other language is spoken aloud.
camera.hint: Point at a sign, menu or page, or upload a photo. Choose the language of the text in the picture in From. Works best with clear printed text; handwriting and blurry photos often fail.
call.title: Group video call with live translated captions
call.hint: Several people, each in their own language. You all see and hear each other, and every sentence appears as a caption in your language. Share the room link to invite people.
call.my_lang: My language (I speak and read this)
call.consent: I understand: my camera and microphone are used; speech recognition may send my voice to my browser's speech service; caption text passes through this server for translation; nothing is recorded or saved.
call.link_sent: Invite link copied. Send it to the people you want to invite.
docs.title: Translate a document
docs.hint: Choose a file; its structure is kept. Supported: .txt .md .srt .vtt .docx .pdf
docs.working: Translating… long files can take a while.
docs.pdf_note: A PDF becomes a translated .txt file; page layout is not kept.
docs.mock: Demo mode: only a few greetings are really translated.
subs.title: Subtitles from audio or video
subs.hint: Choose an audio or video file and the language spoken in it (From). Timing is approximate (15-second blocks). The server needs a speech model and FFmpeg.
history.title: History
setup.title: Setup and translation quality
setup.note: This measures round-trip consistency (English → language → English). It does not prove a translation is correct. Have a fluent speaker review anything important.
setup.mock: DEMO MODE: not real translation. See README to install the model.
setup.running: Checking… this can take a minute.
net.offline_msg: You are offline. Translation needs the internet.
net.slow: Slow connection: low-data mode can help.
about.title: About & honest limits
about.speech: Speech & voices use your browser (Chrome/Edge work best). Listening may send audio to the browser vendor's speech service. Some languages often have no voice or recognizer; the app tells you.
about.mock: Mock mode only knows a few greetings. Install the real model (see README) for real translation.
about.errors: Translations can be wrong, especially for low-resource languages, names and noisy audio.
about.local: History is stored on the computer running this app. Sign in to keep it private to you.
err.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
err.access_required: An access code is required for this action.
err.too_many_attempts: Too many failed logins. Try again in a few minutes.
err.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
err.empty_text: Please enter some text to translate.
err.same_language: The source and target languages are the same.
setup.no_engine: No translation engine is set up yet. Edit the .env file (see README).
data.title: Your data (phrasebook)
data.note: Phrases you add here are used before any engine and work offline. Useful for languages no engine supports.
data.cloud_none: No cloud data source is set. Add DATA_SOURCE_URLS in .env.
connect.title: Connect other systems
connect.note: Other apps and websites can use this translator over HTTP. All endpoints are listed at /docs.
net.retrying: No connection. I will try again when you are back online.
about.privacy: Online engines receive the text you translate. For private text use your phrasebook or a local model.
